itens.trecho: The marketing around this has been terrible, I thought, so I was not really expecting much - but it’s not so very bad after all. That’s almost entirely down to a cheeky and engaging effort from Ben Wang as the young “Li Fong” who has recently (and reluctantly) arrived in Los Angeles from Beijing with his doctor mother (Ming-Na Wen) after a family tragedy…

The «Karate Kid: Legends» (2025) tries to carry the legacy of the original trilogy—«The Karate Kid» (1984), Part II (1986), and Part III (1989)—but it doesn not quite land. Something about it feels off. The heart that made the original films memorable is hard to find here.

While I think Jackie Chan is a wonderful person, I have never found any of his movies to be that great. He is a funny guy, but his movies are not for me. But I loved the original "Karate Kid" and this one was actually a great movie. Some of my favorite actors and with a solid story and emotional it was good!
